flow.notes: TRIGGER — Watches Google Sheet for new prospect rows added by the sales team or scraped from lead sources.
FILTER — Only processes rows where status = 'New' so already-contacted prospects are skipped.
ROUTER — Splits the flow into three parallel paths: Email Outreach, Phone Call, and CRM Logging.

mapper.subject: Booking Opportunity — {{1.talentType}} for {{1.eventType}}
mapper.htmlBody:
Hi {{1.prospectName}},

I'm reaching out from [Your Agency Name] regarding your upcoming {{1.eventType}} on {{1.eventDate}}.

We have top-tier {{1.talentType}} talent available that would be a perfect fit for your event. I'd love to schedule a quick call to discuss details and availability.

You can book a time directly here: Schedule a Call

Looking forward to connecting!

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Agency]

flow.notes: EMAIL — Sends a personalized outreach email to the prospect with event details and a Calendly scheduling link.
DELAY — Waits 3 days (259200 seconds) before sending a follow-up email if no response.

mapper.subject: Re: Booking Opportunity — {{1.talentType}} for {{1.eventType}}
mapper.htmlBody:
Hi {{1.prospectName}},

Just following up on my earlier email about your {{1.eventType}}. We still have availability for {{1.talentType}} talent on {{1.eventDate}}.

Would you like to hop on a quick 10-minute call this week? Book a time here: Schedule a Call

Best,
[Your Name]

flow.notes: FOLLOW-UP EMAIL — Sends an automated follow-up email 3 days after the initial outreach if the prospect hasn't responded.

mapper.twiml: <Response><Say voice='alice'>Hello {{1.prospectName}}. This is a courtesy call from Your Agency Name regarding your upcoming {{1.eventType}}. We have {{1.talentType}} talent available for your event on {{1.eventDate}}. Please check your email for details or press 1 to be connected with a booking agent.</Say><Gather numDigits='1' action='{{YOUR_WEBHOOK_URL}}'><Say>Press 1 to speak with an agent now.</Say></Gather></Response>

flow.notes: PHONE CALL — Uses Twilio to place an automated outreach call to the prospect with a text-to-speech message and option to connect live.
UPDATE SHEET — Marks the prospect row as 'Contacted' with a timestamp so they aren't processed again.
CRM — Creates or updates a contact in HubSpot CRM with all prospect details for pipeline tracking and reporting.

scenario.name: Scenario 1: Prospect Outreach & Contact
scenario.description: Watches for new prospects, sends personalized outreach emails and automated phone calls, logs everything to CRM.
